title: 1866. Number of Ways to Rearrange Sticks With K Sticks Visible

examples.explanation: [1,3,2], [2,3,1], and [2,1,3] are the only arrangements such that exactly 2 sticks are visible. The visible sticks are underlined.
[1,2,3,4,5] is the only arrangement such that all 5 sticks are visible. The visible sticks are underlined.
There are 647427950 (mod 109 + 7) ways to rearrange the sticks such that exactly 11 sticks are visible.
